subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is an orc cleric of Bahamut, a dragon god, and has always been a mystery to others; he refuses to engage in arguments about divine will, free will, or whether a dragon's scale color defines its intrinsic goodness.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is probing Grygum's beliefs about Bahamut, divine intervention, and the nature of dragon god faith, but grows tired of the philosophical debate and receives no answer.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a spellcaster who overpromises on his use of Shape Water but this time succeeds in using it to free the boat from a sandbar, earning rare applause and validation.
source_quote: Daz turns to the group and says, “So?”

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith is a crew member who identifies the sandbar as the cause of the boat's stoppage and sarcastically remarks that oars would have been useful earlier.
source_quote: Sarith shouts, “A sandbar!” ... Sarith laughs, “It would have been useful a while ago…”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a crew member who asks if anyone has oars to help dislodge the boat from the sandbar.

subject: demonic Manta Rays
fact: A swarm of demonic Manta Rays floats in the water near the boat, observed by Daz during the encounter.
source_quote: Daz looks into the war and sees a swarm of those demonic Manta Rays floating in the water.

subject: boat freed from sandbar
fact: Daz successfully uses Shape Water to generate enough water pressure to lift the boat over a sandbar, allowing it to float free into the murky darkness.
source_quote: He casts the spell and uses it to push a small wave over the sandbar. The extra water is enough to move the boat forward. He keeps doing it, and pretty soon, the ship rises over the sand and is free.

subject: Daz's Shape Water potential
fact: Daz's repeated overpromising on Shape Water has created doubt among the group, but this successful use raises questions about whether his ability was underestimated or if this was a rare true instance of his power.
source_quote: They have heard Daz explain how he can use Shape Water, and every time, the promise far exceeds what is delivered... But this time, he is confident.

subject: Darklake
fact: The Darklake is a murky, dark body of water where the boat becomes stranded on a sandbar and is later freed, surrounded by demonic Manta Rays and thick obscurity.
source_quote: As it floats down into the murky darkness...

subject: 10th day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
fact: The date on which the boat becomes stranded on a sandbar and Daz successfully uses Shape Water to free it.
source_quote: ## 10th day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: 9th day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
fact: The date on which Grygum and Jimjar engage in a philosophical stalemate regarding Bahamut, divine will, and dragon god faith.
source_quote: ## 9th day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493
